name: shellway
description: Let your AI agent work on your own computers and servers through Shellway.

interface.longDescription: Shellway connects your AI agent to the computers and servers you own (Windows, Mac, Linux) through a secure MCP relay: run commands, read, write and search files, from any device, with no port forwarding or VPN. Install one small app per computer; 7-day free trial, no card.
defaultPrompt: List my Shellway computers and show disk usage on each
Find the biggest files in my Downloads folder
Check why the nginx service on my server is failing
